# TunnelMaster service sources

Based on [Clash Verge Service IPC v2.7.7](https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-service-ipc/tree/v2.7.7), commit `3ed29700b093190b5e7addcaa892e77f172af544`.

The app and bundled service compile from this shared source with separate TunnelMaster service labels, sockets, state, and core binary names. The service no longer runs the Clash Verge legacy helper uninstaller. The upstream GNU GPL license is included here.
